Standalone entries listed here that don't exist in parsed.json become fully hand-rolled units; they must specify all required fields.

adeptus_mechanicus_archaeopter_fusilave.notes: ADMECH-DIAG: BSData maps four Crusade-only Archeotech upgrade weapons (Electro-fused Vambraces, Nanoshard Projector, Digital Cannon, Neural Jammer) onto Archaeopter chassis as standard ranged profiles. BSData cache Imperium - Adeptus Mechanicus.cat.gz shows each has cost block <cost name=pts value=0/> but <cost name=Crusade Points value=1/>, and all four sit inside an Archeotech selectionEntryGroup with a max=1 constraint - these are CRUSADE narrative upgrades, not matched-play wargear. The BSData mapper has no Crusade-Points filter, so these become primary+secondary+extras and the simulator fires several of them per shooting phase. Real Fusilave datasheet (Wahapedia https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/adeptus-mechanicus/#Archaeopter-Fusilave): only Cognis heavy stubber array (twin-linked, 36in 9A S4 AP0 D1 Sustained 1, Rapid Fire 9), Bombs (one-shot Drop Bomb action, not modelled), and Armoured hull (melee). Structural fix (Crusade-Points filter in code/bsdata/mapper.py) is iter 31-45 mapper phase 2.

Real Stratoraptor datasheet (Wahapedia https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/adeptus-mechanicus/#Archaeopter-Stratoraptor): Twin cognis lascannon (already primary), Cognis heavy stubber array (36in 9A S4 AP0 D1 Sustained 1, Rapid Fire 9), Armoured hull (melee). chaos_knights_library_knight_rampager.notes: SC5-2: 5+ Ion Shield missing from BSData Chaos Knights Library (no Invulnerable Save infoLink). See chaos_knights_library_knight_desecrator notes. | KNIGHTS-MULTIPROFILE-2: Knight Rampager's datasheet equipment line lists BOTH a Reaper chainsword AND a Warpstrike claw (Wahapedia: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/chaos-knights/Knight-Rampager), and both fire every Fight phase against the same engaged target. The BSData mapper picks only one (Warpstrike claw strike at A=6 S=20 AP=-3 D=8 [SUSTAINED HITS 1]) and stores it as the primary melee profile. Reaper chainsword strike profile (A=6 WS=2+ S=14 AP=-4 D=6 [SUSTAINED HITS 1]) is added here as an ADDITIVE extra_melee_profile so the chassis's full melee output is represented. The strike (rather than sweep) profile is the standard pick against most opposing models; the AI does not yet flex strike/sweep per target. hit_probability 0.833 = 5/6 = WS 2+.

chaos_knights_library_knight_despoiler.notes: SC5-2: 5+ Ion Shield missing from BSData Chaos Knights Library (no Invulnerable Save infoLink). See chaos_knights_library_knight_desecrator notes. | KNIGHTS-MULTIPROFILE-3: Knight Despoiler's datasheet 'equipped with' line carries BOTH a Reaper chainsword AND a Warpstrike claw simultaneously (Wahapedia: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/chaos-knights/Knight-Despoiler â 'This model is equipped with: reaper chainsword; warpstrike claw; titanic feet'; the wargear options only allow each weapon to be REPLACED by ranged alternatives, so the default loadout keeps both). The BSData mapper picks Warpstrike claw strike (A=4 WS3+ S20 AP-3 D8) as the primary melee profile; Reaper chainsword strike profile (A=4 WS3+ S14 AP-4 D6, BSData cache: Chaos - Chaos Knights Library.cat.gz selectionEntry 'Reaper chainsword' WS3+ strike) is added here as an ADDITIVE extra_melee_profile per the same Fight-phase multi-melee-weapon resolution that wires the Knight Rampager. hit_probability 0.667 = 4/6 = WS 3+. Strike (not sweep) is the standard pick against most opposing models the Despoiler engages; the AI does not yet flex strike/sweep per target. Titanic feet (A=4 WS4+ S8 AP-1 D2) are intentionally left out of the extras: they appear on every Knight datasheet and their contribution is negligible compared to Reaper / Warpstrike, matching the KNIGHTS-MULTIPROFILE-2 convention. | DESPOILER-GUN-BUILD (2026-07-02): the invuln_save fix and the Reaper-chainsword extra_melee_profile above describe the MELEE-arms reading of this chassis; the sourced competitive build is a GUN platform instead, so a model_loadouts override is added here (the imperial_knights_library_knight_tyrant precedent) to replace the mapper's expected-value picker's melee resolve on the default per-model-loadouts path (SWEG_PERMODEL=1, default-on). Both arms (reaper chainsword and warpstrike claw slots) are replaced with the paired 'despoiler gatling cannon and 1 heavy darkflamer' wargear option (Wahapedia Knight Despoiler wargear list: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/chaos-knights/Knight-Despoiler -- "This model's reaper chainsword can be replaced with one of the following: 1 daemonbreath thermal cannon; 1 despoiler gatling cannon and 1 heavy darkflamer; 1 despoiler battle cannon and 1 diabolus heavy stubber" and the identical clause for the warpstrike claw), giving 2x Despoiler gatling cannon + 2x Heavy darkflamer. The shoulder-mounted Daemonbreath meltagun is kept at its BSData default (not swapped for the Diabolus heavy stubber alternative): sourced 2026 tournament lists split roughly evenly between the two (the Cominus and Eminus three-Despoiler Infernal Lance list ran Diabolus heavy stubber on all three, while the Berry Roll two-Despoiler list and the Line of Sight Wargaming battle report both kept Daemonbreath meltagun), so the BSData default is kept per the project's minimal-change convention rather than guessing a majority off a small, split sample. The Ruinspear rocket pod (the model's optional third 'additional loadout' slot) IS added because it is consistently present across every sourced 2026 competitive list found, not guessed: every Knight Despoiler entry in both lists fetched from the League Wars 2025-2026 Ligue 3 Centre tournament repository (https://www.miniheadquarters.com/tournaments/team/army-lists/league-wars-2025-2026-ligue-3-centre-match-aller-2026-06-30, fetched 2026-07-02) carries it, matching the Line of Sight Wargaming report (https://lineofsightwargaming.com/2025/06/21/six-big-chaos-knights-3-games/, Despoiler Warlord: "Gatling Cannon x2, Heavy Darkflamer x2, Ruinspear Rocket Pod, Meltagun"). The double-gatling-cannon build itself is confirmed as the dominant competitive choice, not merely a legal option, by the Tabletop Battles Chaos Knights competitive faction focus (https://www.tabletopbattles.com/10th-edition-competitive-faction-focus-chaos-knights/, updated November 18 2025: "Competitive Chaos Knight lists tend to start with at least two and probably three Knights Despoiler, each armed with a pair of Gatling Cannons... pound for pound one of the most devastating units in the game", and naming "four big, double double gatling Infernals" the strongest Chaos Knights list at the time of writing). Melee is narrowed to Titanic feet ONLY (attacks 4, weapon skill 4+, strength 8, armour penetration -1, damage 2, BSData cache Chaos - Chaos Knights Library.cat.gz selectionEntry 'Titanic feet') because both arms are now guns; the reaper chainsword and warpstrike claw no longer exist on this loadout. All six ranged weapon profiles and the melee profile were cross-checked verbatim against BSData cache Chaos - Chaos Knights Library.cat.gz (Despoiler gatling cannon 36 inch range, 18 attacks, ballistic skill 3+, strength 6, armour penetration -2, damage 2; Heavy darkflamer 12 inch range, D6 attacks, no ballistic skill roll [Torrent, auto-hit], strength 5, armour penetration -1, damage 1, keywords Torrent plus Ignores Cover -- note strength 5, not the strength 6 first assumed before checking the cache; Daemonbreath meltagun 12 inch range, 1 attack, ballistic skill 3+, strength 9, armour penetration -4, damage D6, Melta 2; Ruinspear rocket pod 48 inch range, 3 attacks, ballistic skill 3+, strength 8, armour penetration -2, damage D6, no keywords; Titanic feet as above). The pre-existing top-level extra_melee_profiles entry (Reaper chainsword) and the base mapper-picked top-level ranged and melee fields are left untouched so the SWEG_PERMODEL=0 legacy path still reproduces its pre-fix, byte-identical baseline; only the model_loadouts entry (the default SWEG_PERMODEL=1 path) carries the sourced gun build.

chaos_knights_library_knight_tyrant.notes: Faithful loadout override (2026-06-30) — restore the Knight Tyrant's DROPPED CARAPACE gun. The BSData mapper's single-model picker resolves the Tyrant's 'Carapace weapons' group to no candidates, so the catalogue Tyrant fired only its 12-inch Warpshock harpoon + twin meltagun. This minimal correction keeps those two real weapons and ADDS the dropped Gheiststrike missile launcher (72-inch carapace, real datasheet weapon, Wahapedia chaos-knights/Knight-Tyrant). Note: the Tyrant still under-fires because the move AI advances it (forfeiting shooting) — that is the metric-blocked advance-discipline piloting issue, not the loadout. See the mapper-fix residual in docs/DECISION_LEDGER.md.

adepta_sororitas_celestian_insidiants.notes: SOROR-DIAG-6: BSData parsed.json captures fnp=4 on Celestian Insidiants, derived from the datasheet ability 'Rituale Nullificatus' which (per Wahapedia) reads: 'Models in this unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against Psychic Attacks and against mortal wounds.' The simulator's Feel No Pain check has no psychic / mortal-wound gate â applying fnp=4 statically grants the unit a blanket 4+ FNP against ALL damage, including regular bolter shots, which is a massive defensive over-buff for a 10-model T3 Sv3+ squad at 120pts. Same SC5-8 / SC5-10 / SORORITAS-MORTIFIER-FNP prose-walk pattern: BSData's extract_fnp pulls FNP text from a conditional datasheet rule into the static profile. Reset to 7 (no static Feel No Pain) â the conditional psychic/mortal-wound FNP 4+ belongs in code (not yet implemented); under-approximating here is the conservative direction since wave 23 has Sororitas sim 68.5% vs real 50.8% (+13.92pt over-perf, gated). Insidiants is in the Hallowed Martyrs archetype list (code/archetypes.py:1089), so this lands directly on the Sororitas eval signal. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/adepta-sororitas/Celestian-Insidiants. SOROR-FAB-AUDIT: Sororitas detachment audit (HALLOWED_MARTYRS + BRINGERS_OF_FLAME) found no fab flags to remove â both detachments already ship no-flag after SC5-4 and DET-VARIETY-1. The remaining +15.82pt gated over-perf (wave 24, sim 70.4% vs real 50.8%) tracks back to a unit-level mapper amalgamation on this unit's primary weapon. BSData parsed.json packs the Insidiants primary as 'Ministorum hand flamer' with attacks=2, strength=5, ap=-1, weapon_damage_per_shot=1.2, hit_probability=0.8 (BS 3+), devastating_wounds=true â a hybrid profile that matches NEITHER real weapon the unit carries. Wahapedia datasheet (https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/adepta-sororitas/Celestian-Insidiants) shows the actual loadout: 9 Insidiants + 1 Superior, default ranged weapon on the model = Condemnor bolt pistol (12", A=1, BS=3+, S=4, AP=0, D=1, [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] + [ANTI-PSYKER 4+] + [PISTOL]). Only 1 model in 10 swaps its Condemnor for a hand flamer, 1 in 10 swaps for an inferno pistol â neither swap is unit-majority. The hand flamer profile in BSData (id c462-3995-88b0-200c) is correctly defined as A=D6, S=4, AP=0, D=1, [Ignores Cover, Pistol, Torrent] with NO Devastating Wounds; the inflated 2-attack S5 AP-1 D1.2 mapping is a mapper composite that combines several wrong sources (likely the Devastating Wounds keyword leaked from Condemnor bolt pistol, AP-1 leaked from Null mace melee weapon, attacks/damage averaged across the variant model profiles). Setting primary weapon stats to the real Condemnor bolt pistol profile: drops per-shot damage from inflated ~24 wounds/round (2A * 10 models * 0.8 hit * D1.2 with Devastating Wounds) to ~6.7 wounds/round (1A * 10 models * 0.667 hit * D1 with Devastating Wounds), a ~17 wound/round reduction. Anti-PSYKER 4+ is omitted from this override pass â the simulator's anti_keywords field supports it but the gain is marginal vs non-psyker targets in the archetype-vs-archetype eval. The melee Null mace profile is unchanged (parsed A=3 vs real A=2 is a minor over-buff but inside noise compared to the ranged delta). Hand flamer + inferno pistol variants on 2 of the 10 models are dropped from the override; their contribution is small and packing them into extra_ranged_profiles would re-introduce the multi-profile mapper problem the cleanup is meant to fix. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/adepta-sororitas/Celestian-Insidiants

orks_stompa.notes: Multi-weapon override (option 1 / pass 1). The Stompa carries six ranged weapons but BSData's tree exposes only the Deffkannon (primary in the simulator: A=3D6 -> 10 shots, S14, AP-3, D6 Blast) and the Supa-gatler (secondary: 20 shots, S7, AP-1, D2, Sustained Hits 1). The other three weapon profiles are absent from the cache: 3 Big Shootas + 1 Twin Big Shoota (Rapid Fire 2, 36", S5 AP0 D1), the Skorcha (D6 shots, 12" Torrent, S5 AP-1 D1, Ignores Cover), and the Supa-rokkits (D6 shots, 100", S12 AP-3 D6+2, Blast). The simulator runs Stompa with roughly 60-70%% of its real shooting output, which is the primary reason it collapses in the equation fit. As a stopgap until the mapper learns to compose multi-weapon profiles, we route the Supa-rokkits' anti-vehicle contribution into the primary slot (Deffkannon-like S14/AP-3) by bumping attacks 10 -> 14, and the Big Shootas + Twin Big Shoota + Skorcha anti-infantry contribution into the secondary slot (Supa-gatler-like S7/AP-1) by bumping attacks 20 -> 32. Keyword booleans (Blast on primary, Sustained Hits 1 on secondary) are kept as-is from BSData. The override is rough Ã¢â¬â different missing weapons have different S/AP profiles so any single-slot aggregation distorts target-type efficiency Ã¢â¬â but it lifts Stompa's expected damage from ~12 to ~17 vs a baseline Marine, which matches the Wahapedia datasheet. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/orks/Stompa
